passages.provision_quote: The right to marry is a fundamental right.
passages.note: Bill text matches rung 2's recognition clause, but every recorded vote on this instrument was near-unanimous.
Wiener voted Aye on ACA 5's Senate Floor passage, which carried 31-0 with zero Noes on every recorded vote on this bill.
passages.tally_quote: Ayes Count 31 Noes Count 0 NVR Count 9

rows.reasoning: ACA 5's operative text matches rung 2 (it secures the right to marry with no anti-discrimination or religious-exemption clause), and Wiener voted Aye on it in both Senate Judiciary and the Senate Floor. But every recorded vote on this instrument shows 0 Noes (e.g., Senate Floor Ayes Count 31 Noes Count 0), which V4 'near-unanimous' says cannot carry the chair alone, and no sponsorship or own-words statement from Wiener is available to supplement it.
